items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1959-07-16
items.q: Because he worked with Tony for, for a number of years at that, the Vita.

ctx.x: What's his name anyway? Full name, do you remember? Ramis?

Oh, by the way, what about Rag Baby Steelers? Who did he play with mostly?
